intro: The Newport Plaza retail podium is the retail and F&B component of Newport Plaza at 80 Anson Road, in District 2, developed by City Developments Limited. CDL’s construction page, current as at 2 November 2026 and as recorded in our project file, lists an indicative TOP in the fourth quarter of 2027 for the mixed development. That is a developer estimate, not an obtained TOP, and a separate retail opening date is unconfirmed. The file notes F&B at level 1. This page covers the retail podium only. Newport Residences and Newport Tower are the residential and office components of the same parent development and should not be counted again here. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Newport Plaza retail podium fit-out.

sections.heading: Planning your Newport Plaza retail podium interior
sections.text:
Because this is a city-fringe podium, the useful conversation with Maison is a shop or F&B fit-out, not a home renovation. Incoming tenants typically need a shopfront and signage package the landlord will accept, fitted joinery for display, a counter, and a compact back-of-house, designed to the approved tenancy plan rather than to a guessed bay size. Food and beverage trades at level 1 will need coordinated extraction, grease, water and electrical capacity, and should not be designed from a dry-retail layout. Maison specifies built-in carpentry for those interiors, not loose, flat-pack fixtures. No official tenancy floor plan is on file.

Newport Residences, packed earlier, and Newport Tower, in this batch, are the correct cross-links. 39 Robinson Road and Shaw Tower are nearby central links only. We will not invent walking times to Tanjong Pagar or to any station, and we will not assign a view or a frontage to a unit we have not seen.

Once a lease and an indicative handover are in writing, work backwards: defects and landlord inspection, a measured survey, landlord and trade approvals, then fabrication. A modest non-food shop fit-out is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after approvals; food trades can take longer. That is an editorial allowance, not a guarantee. WhatsApp Maison with your tenancy plan and permitted trade. We are not affiliated with CDL.

faq.q: When is TOP or opening at Newport Plaza retail podium?
faq.a: Our project file records: 2027-Q4 indicative TOP. Where the note says indicative, targeted or expected, treat it as an estimate, not an obtained TOP or an opening day.
